# DSC 650 Final Project
# HBase commands for the Loan Approval Prediction ML pipeline.

# Create the table that will store model-performance metrics
# generated by the PySpark MLlib application.
create 'loan_model_metrics', 'metrics'

# Verify that the table is empty before Spark writes model metrics.
scan 'loan_model_metrics'

# After the Spark MLlib application executes and writes its
# model-performance metrics to HBase, run this scan again
# to verify that the metrics were successfully stored.
scan 'loan_model_metrics'
